issues.label: Unsupported claim
issues.instructions: Does any caption make a strong factual, performance, or comparative claim without visible support?

issues.label: Absolute wording
issues.instructions: Does any caption use absolute wording such as always, never, guaranteed, safest, or best in a way that creates review risk?

issues.label: Sensitive wording
issues.instructions: Does any caption contain potentially discriminatory, stigmatizing, or needlessly inflammatory wording?
